functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the code meets the stated requirements and produces the correct outputs for given inputs.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses how well the code handles edge cases that may not be explicitly stated in the prompt.

efficiency.description: Measures the time complexity of the solution and checks if it meets specified performance requirements.

robustness.description: Evaluates the code's ability to handle unexpected inputs without crashing or producing incorrect results.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriate and effective use of APIs or libraries in the solution.

readability_maintainability.description: Evaluates the clarity, organization, and structure of the code to ensure it is easy to read and maintain.

error_security_handling.description: Assesses how well the code handles potential errors and security vulnerabilities.
